scope: Server interactive/edit production paths and native tests
Agent turn orchestration, recorded history, graph presentation and configuration
Read-only review of exmekh_lib file processing, interactive provider contracts and public class responsibilities

changes.result: Shared limits, version, edit markers, description, diagnostics and messages have one configuration owner. Serialized version and accepted version derive from the same constant.
Related parser arguments use edit_document_input and interactive_edit_input. Generic behavior callback signatures remain compatible.
A contradictory snapshot is rejected without assigning an ID or mutating pending authorization. ID assignment is published after validation.
Final arguments must contain the exact document property compiled from the tool definition.
The worker receives one typed AgentTurnRequest instead of duplicating the public argument list. Public caller compatibility is preserved.
TitleGenerationSettings owns configurable sampling, normalization and fallback, exposed through methods used by the runner.
The graph obtains an owned normalized root prompt through ChatMessage and RecordedHistory. It does not duplicate transcript interpretation or borrow child prompts.
Previously inline colors, palette and main history identity are read from presentation configuration.

audit.classification: AST screening identifies review candidates; counts alone do not establish violations. Configuration and capability resources are excluded from literal exception screening.
library_classes_reviewed: EditApproval: authorization, evidence, encoding and commit delegated through methods
EditDocument/EditElement: literal document parsing and domain data
FileToolRuntime/FileInspectionHistory: visible provenance and batch prerequisites
InteractiveContract: wire authorization independent of HTTP
FileEditFormat/FileEditingSettings: fixed grammar versus operational limits and messages
audit.private_access_classification: Copies of the same class may use private methods; namedtuple._replace is a documented API. No mechanical private-to-public renaming was applied.
audit.argument_policy: Group related values when the grouping represents a real request or domain concept; retain explicit callback and compatibility boundaries.

native: make test-server-interactive: PASS including two added regressions
ds4-server CUDA build/link: PASS, binary not launched
Interactive parser AddressSanitizer + UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer with leak detection: PASS
validation.extra_library_lint_and_typecheck: NOT_RUN: automatic approval review could not complete because its account quota was exhausted. These checks do not invalidate the completed non-live library test run.

remaining: ds4_server.c and inference/backend modules remain large; extraction needs separate semantic and performance verification.
Graph traversal and page turn orchestration still contain long functions; typed request grouping does not by itself split all responsibilities.
The public agent entry point intentionally retains its existing parameter API; the implementation boundary uses one request object.
Some provider wire identifiers and protocol version literals remain in exmekh_lib; moving them is a possible follow-up requiring provider tests and a rebuilt wheel.
No exhaustive semantic certification of every class or all clean-code principles is claimed.
The previously reproduced steering cache defect is not fixed by this refactoring.

follow_up.note: Historical outcomes above describe the earlier review. The follow-up modifies the library, centralizes its interactive protocol and qualifies the wheel and server live, including cancellation followed by an auxiliary request.
